status: pre-outcome development analysis lock; not a preregistered heldout study
purpose: test verifier refresh transfer to new tasks without paid evaluation-task labels
insufficient_unique_sources: use all available, report lower actual cost, never replace task

primary.contrast: refreshed minus frozen expected trusted pass probability on 16 unseen tasks

controls: frozen verifier: additional shared labels released after decisions
refreshed verifier: additional shared labels released before decisions
cost_semantics: same distinct training-source identities and same simulated paid-source oracle ledger on a fully scored development bank; zero decision-time evaluation-task labels; all physical bank scoring and reference validations reported separately
scope: fixed base generator; learned linear verifier and fresh-task selection, no generator parameter update or self-improvement claim
outcome_selection: all 16 evaluation tasks, including zero-success tasks
uncertainty: paired task bootstrap descriptive intervals; no tuning on evaluation outcomes
abort_conditions: development task IDs or sample count mismatch
scored-bank hash or frozen-split provenance mismatch
trusted label inconsistent for an exact within-task source
